Rainphil Quotation Generator

Fills your standard quotation template from item rows entered below. Runs in your browser. Contact saves are sent only to the Google Apps Script endpoint you configure.

Load from Google Sheet

In your sheet: File → Share → Publish to web → select the price-log tab → CSV → Publish, then paste that link below.
The program filters all items by Quotation Number. If you add Attention Name and Attention Position columns, historical contacts from this sheet will also be available per client.
Selecting a quote loads its items automatically.
Point this at your existing CRM / Leads & Accounts sheet — no need to duplicate data. It needs an account name column (Account, Company, or Company Name) and, if present, will also pick up Client Address/Address and a default contact from Attention Name/Contact Name + Attention Position/Position. Publish that tab as CSV and paste the link below.
New contacts are automatically written to the Price-offer spreadsheet through the configured Apps Script Web App.
The quotation sheet is also checked for Attention Name and Attention Position. Add a contact to the price-offer sheet once, and it will be available for that client on future quotations. Contacts from CRM, Price-offer, and Synced Contacts are merged and deduplicated.

Quotation details

Used for the generated filename only. The Internal Quote No. prefix (e.g. SIC26-024) is pulled automatically from the CSV.
Select multiple contacts when the quotation should address more than one person. Each selected name and position is placed on its own line.
A title will be predicted from the quotation items when available.
